name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
summary: A static stretch performed by bending one arm behind the head and gently pulling the elbow with the opposite hand to lengthen the triceps.

setup: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed.
Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, reaching your hand down toward the center of your upper back.
steps: Grasp the raised elbow with your opposite hand.
Gently pull the elbow toward your midline and slightly backward until a mild stretch is felt in the back of your upper arm.
Hold the position smoothly without bouncing, then release and repeat on the opposite side.
instructions.breathing: Breathe slowly and deeply throughout the hold, relaxing into the stretch on each exhale.
cues: Keep your chest upright and avoid arching your lower back.
Reach your fingertips down between your shoulder blades.
Pull gently to the point of mild tension, not pain.

common_faults.fault: Hyperextending the lumbar spine to force the arm further back.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core and keep your ribcage down to maintain a neutral spine.

common_faults.fault: Pushing the head and neck forward.
common_faults.correction: Keep your neck in line with your spine and your gaze forward throughout the stretch.

precautions: Avoid aggressive downward pulling if you experience shoulder impingement or pain.
